cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 84 since 2010. Lives in Eufaula and worked for American Buildings there. Wikipedia says he previously served as a Barbour County Commissioner. He was born in 1937.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as receiving a voter guide recommendation from the Russell County ADC (Sway voting group by James York Jr) for 2026.

cands.gaps: The pages I had don't say where Forte was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. They don't list the bills he sponsored, and I found no statements from him on data centers, property taxes, land buying, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2022 or 2026. I couldn't confirm when he served as a Barbour County Commissioner, since only one short source mentions it. I found no documented controversies or foreign ties.
